name: reel-studio
description: Your reel editor inside Claude. Drop in a video and say what you want — rough cut, captions, sounds, stickers, CapCut export. Everything runs on your own computer.
long_description: Reel Studio edits short-form videos on your own computer: rough cut, brand captions, real sound effects, CapCut-style text, animation windows, CapCut project export and a review page with voice notes. Your videos never leave your computer. Uses your own Claude plan for the thinking. Needs an active Reel Studio subscription (licence key from your Systems Pilot account).
